tei:titleStmt.tei:title: An den Hauptfesten, wenn man Behufs der üblichen Vorlesungen die Gesetzrolle aus der heiligen Lade nimmt
On the Shalosh Regalim when one removes the Torah from the holy Ark, a teḥinah by Yehoshua Heshil Miro (1829)

tei:div.tei:head: An den Hauptfesten, wenn man Behufs der üblichen Vorlesungen die Gesetzrolle aus der heiligen Lade nimmt

tei:lg.tei:l: On the Shalosh Regalim, when one removes the Torah from the holy ark for the customary readings.

The Eternal is unchangeable, the eternal being, an almighty God, all-merciful and all-gracious, long-suffering of infinite mercy and faithfulness, who still reserves his mercy for the thousandth generation, who forgives iniquity, apostasy and sin, but who lets nothing go by without punishment. (Exodus 34:6-7 part)

Lord of the world, grant the desires of my heart if they are for my good. Let my enterprise succeed and hear the prayer of your servant. Make me (my husband, my sons and daughters) able to fulfill your will with a sincere heart; let no passion rule over us; let your teaching be our portion! Let the spirit of wisdom and understanding rule over us. Let the saying of the Holy Scripture be fulfilled in us: “And the spirit of God shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and strength, the spirit of knowledge and the fear of the Lord.” (Isaiah 11:2)

So also may it be agreeable to you, Eternal our God, that I may be so fortunate as to perform actions that are pleasing to you, to walk in ways that are right in your sight. Sanctify us by your commandment, that we may attain to the blessed life, to the life of the better world. Protect us from evil deeds, from awful moments that overtake us in life. Whoever trusts in God, grace surrounds them. Amen.

tei:note.tei:p: Here the praying person turns on her name.
